pairs.evidence: src/lib/catalog/ue-schema.ts:61 ueSchema() serves a committed JSON snapshot of UE headers that records no fingerprint of the headers it came from, and ue-schema-parity checks step fields against it with only a manual refresh note, so a UE header change leaves the parity suite green against yesterday's schema.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/catalog/ue-schema.ts:61 The derived fixture names no inputs and nothing checks whether it is fresh; the rebuild is the manual `npm run snapshot:ue-schema` (ue-schema-parity.test.ts:3).

src/__tests__/catalog/ue-schema-parity.test.ts:14 Floors on the snapshot size and on the declared-step count stop the parity loop from selecting zero cases (the snapshot had been `{}` for four months).
